manifest.material: heathered sweatshirt knit with a visibly napped inner hood surface and rib-knit finishing
manifest.subtype: full-zip hooded sweatshirt with curved front panel seams, split pouch pockets and paneled balloon sleeves
manifest.fit: oversized, dropped shoulders, wide body and voluminous sleeves gathered into fitted cuffs
manifest.construction: The garment has a full-length center-front zipper, a drawcord hood, dropped shoulder sleeve attachments, two front pouch-pocket halves, rib-knit cuffs and a divided rib-knit bottom band. Raised, continuous curved sewn joins divide the upper front from the lower front on both sides of the zipper. Additional curved sewn joins define lower outer sleeve panels; these are not fold boundaries. The hood opening has a turned, sewn drawcord casing, and its visible inner fabric has a central join. The front panel curves, sleeve contours and bottom edge are traced in their photographed, slightly asymmetric arrangement rather than symmetrized. The bottom band rises toward the center-front zipper and drops farther on the image-right side. The zipper, slider and drawcords are functional details. Chest and sleeve artwork is excluded, with uninterrupted fabric retained beneath it.
manifest.materialEvidence: The exterior has fine heathered knit texture, the hood interior shows a soft raised nap, and the cuffs and bottom band show finer longitudinal rib structure. These support sweatshirt knit and rib knit; the fiber composition is not observable.
uncertainties: Cotton content and other fiber percentages cannot be determined visually.
The hood's hidden rear extent and whether its inner surface is a separate lining or the reverse of the main knit cannot be confirmed.
Some stitching is too fine to resolve into separate rows; only distinguishable finished edges and stitch tracks are recorded.
The sleeve panel joins are visible, but their continuations around the unseen backs of the sleeves are not reconstructed.
Pocket and bottom-band edges immediately beside the zipper are partly obscured by the closure.
Compare the technical redraw with the original photo for construction fidelity. The overlay and pixel metrics compare the SVG against the redraw, not the photograph.
The traced construction ink stays together. No semantic colour fills or separately editable stitch paths are inferred.
Potrace smoothing and turdsize 4 may remove tiny specks; inspect the overlay and fidelity metrics.

regions.evidence: Cord exits the image-right hood casing and hangs in a shallow curve to a knot.

visibleEdges.evidence: An overlapping cord turn is visible within the terminal knot.

regions.label: Left outer hood
regions.evidence: Hood surface bounded by the outer silhouette, face rim and stitched neckline join. The recovered division beside the drawcord does not establish a separate sewn component.

regions.label: Right outer hood
regions.evidence: Outer hood fabric extends around the face rim to the stitched neckline join, matching the opposite hood half.

regions.label: Left visible inner hood
regions.evidence: The face rim reveals an inner hood surface with a central seam continuing from the crown. The lateral curved line has no distinct stitched join and is retained within this folded inner surface.

regions.label: Right visible inner hood
regions.evidence: Visible inner hood fabric is bounded by the face rim and central crown seam. The narrow lateral subdivision is treated as a fold rather than an independently sewn panel.

regions.label: Left drawcord with knot and end
regions.evidence: Parallel cord outlines descend from the hood rim into a visibly enclosed knot and short hanging end.

regions.label: Right drawcord with knot and end
regions.evidence: Enclosed hanging cord, knot and terminal segment are visibly distinct from the hood and chest fabric.

regions.label: Left upper chest and shoulder yoke
regions.evidence: A continuous curved chest join with parallel dashed topstitching separates this upper component from the lower body. Its shoulder extension terminates at the stitched sleeve join.

regions.label: Right upper chest and shoulder yoke
regions.evidence: The curved solid chest seam and accompanying topstitching establish a separate upper construction piece, continuing into the shoulder above the sleeve join.

regions.label: Left lower front body
regions.evidence: Exposed body fabric lies between the sewn curved chest join and hem-band join. The recovered pocket perimeter separates the visible patch pocket from this surface.

regions.label: Right lower front body
regions.evidence: Lower front fabric is bounded by the topstitched chest seam, side outline, centre closure and hem join, with the recovered patch-pocket surface kept separate.

regions.label: Left main sleeve
regions.evidence: Sleeve fabric starts at the transverse stitched upper-arm join and continues to the cuff, beside a curved topstitched lower-sleeve insert.

regions.label: Right main sleeve
regions.evidence: The upper-arm joining seam, outer sleeve silhouette and curved stitched insert boundary define the main sleeve component.

regions.label: Left curved lower-sleeve insert
regions.evidence: A long curved solid seam with parallel topstitching encloses a distinct lower-sleeve panel ending at the gathered cuff join.

regions.label: Right curved lower-sleeve insert
regions.evidence: Curved seam and adjacent dashed stitching distinguish this insert from the main sleeve; small cuff wrinkles remain within the panel.

regions.label: Left split kangaroo pocket
regions.evidence: Recovered cell follows the visible patch-pocket top, curved hand-entry edge and stitched lower attachment. Only the exposed pocket surface is included.

regions.label: Right split kangaroo pocket
regions.evidence: The horizontal top edge, curved stitched entry and lower attachment identify an independent patch-pocket surface beside the centre zip.

regions.label: Left hem band
regions.evidence: A continuous stitched attachment line separates this band from the lower front, with a distinct curved free bottom edge.

regions.label: Right hem band
regions.evidence: Stitched upper join and free lower edge define a separate hem-band half ending at the centre closure.

regions.label: Left wrist cuff
regions.evidence: A narrow enclosed wrist band attaches below the gathered sleeve through a visible stitched seam.

regions.label: Right wrist cuff
regions.evidence: The wrist band has its own outline and stitched attachment beneath the sleeve gathers.
